wikipedia.text: At the 18th G20 summit in New Delhi, the African Union is announced as the 21st permanent member of the G20.

labels.text: Rahul Gandhi, the official opposition leader of India is disqualified from the Lok Sabha after he was convicted in a defamation case filed by BJP MLA, Purnesh Modi.
India surpasses China as most populous country.
2023 Manipur violence: Ethnic violence erupts in the state of Manipur between the Kuki and Meitei people.
A train collision in Odisha, India results in at least 296 deaths and more than 1,200 others injured.
Indian oil refiners start payments for Russian oil imports in Chinese yuan as an alternative to the US dollar due to increasing sanctions against Russia.
The Narendra Modi led NDA government wins a no confidence motion in the Lok Sabha moved by the INDIA Alliance after an opposition walkout in response to the ethnic violence in the state of Manipur.
India's Chandrayaan-3 becomes the first spacecraft to land near the south pole of the Moon, carrying a lunar lander named Vikram and a lunar rover named Pragyan.
The Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO) successfully launches Aditya-L1, India's first solar observation mission.
At the 18th G20 summit in New Delhi, the African Union is announced as the 21st permanent member of the G20.
The 2023 Cricket World Cup is held in India, with Australia defeating India in the final.
Ram Mandir Pran Pratishtha: The Ram Mandir is inaugurated by Prime Minister, Narendra Modi in Ayodhya, Uttar Pradesh.
The 2024 ICC Men's T20 World Cup is co-hosted by the West Indies and the United States, and is won by India.
At least 334 people are killed, over 200 injured, and 281 missing following landslides in Wayanad district, Kerala, India.
Prime Minister of Bangladesh Sheikh Hasina announces her resignation and flees to India following nationwide protests.

Indian chess prodigy Gukesh Dommaraju defeats former world champion Ding Liren in the 2024 World Chess Championship, breaking the previous age record of 22 set by Garry Kasparov by becoming champion at 18 years, 195 days old.

Pakistan backed attackers affiliated with The Resistance Front open fire on a group of tourists after asking their religion at the Baisaran Valley in Jammu and Kashmir, India, killing 26 and injuring at least 20.
2025 India–Pakistan conflict: India launches several missiles into Pakistani territory in response to the 2025 Pahalgam attack two weeks prior.

Air India Flight 171, a London-bound Boeing 787, crashes into a building after take-off from Ahmedabad, India, killing 229 passengers, 12 crew on board, and 19 people on the ground. One passenger survives the crash. It is the first fatal crash and hull loss involving a Boeing 787 Dreamliner.

The Axiom Mission 4 is launched. The mission involves four astronauts, including the first astronauts from Poland (Sławosz Uznański-Wiśniewski) and India (Shubhanshu Shukla) since the end of the Cold War.

2025 Karur crowd crush: At least 40 people are killed and 51 injured in a crowd crush at a rally held by actor-turned-politician Vijay's party Tamilaga Vettri Kazhagam (TVK) in Karur, Tamil Nadu, India.
2025 Delhi Red Fort blast: At least 15 people are killed and more than 20 people are injured in a car explosion near the Red Fort in Delhi.
Flooding and landslides caused by Cyclone Ditwah leave at least 647 dead and 183 missing across Sri Lanka and South India.
A fire at a nightclub in Arpora, Goa, India, leaves at least 25 people dead and 50 injured.
The India–European Union Free Trade Agreement is signed after nearly two decades of negotiations, eliminating Tariffs on a broad range of products and services between the two regions.
The 2026 Men's T20 World Cup held in India and Sri Lanka begins.
The AI Impact Summit takes place in New Delhi, India.
India beats New Zealand in the 2026 Men's T20 World Cup final and secures its third title.

2026 Delhi Jantar Mantar protests: A series of demonstrations takes place in Jantar Mantar, New Delhi, initiated by the Cockroach Janta Party, an Indian youth-based satirical political movement, along with other student organisations.
Flash flooding and landslides kill at least 56 people in India and at least 14 people in Nepal. For Nepal this occurs one month on from devastating floods.
